name: Virtual Mind XR
summary:
Think in space. Virtual Mind XR is a mixed reality mind-mapping app for Meta Quest 3 and 3S that places your ideas around you, in your own room, using only your hands.

MAPS YOU CAN TOUCH
- Create a note from the menu on your palm, grab it, move it, and link notes by pulling a line from one to another.
- Each map stays where you left it in your room.
- One tap arranges everything neatly around you.

WRITE, SPEAK, SHOW
- Dictate notes by voice or type on a floating keyboard.
